load_voc_instances: load Pascal VOC detection annotations from XML files into Detectron2 dataset dictionary format
register_pascal_voc: register a Pascal VOC dataset split with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for object detection
parse_voc_bbox: parse Pascal VOC bounding box coordinates from XML annotation files and convert to zero-based XYXY format
summarize_CLASS_NAMES: summarize the 20 Pascal VOC class names including aeroplane, bicycle, bird, boat, bottle, bus, car, cat, chair, cow, diningtable, dog, horse, motorbike, person, pottedplant, sheep, sofa, train, tvmonitor
review_load_voc_instances: review the load_voc_instances function to understand how it reads ImageSets split files and parses XML annotations
